protocol.brainProfileAmendment: Before pilot answers: direct DeepSeek account returned credit exhaustion in development smoke. New named v2 profile uses Gateway Gemini 3.6 Flash brain; original profile retained.
protocol.continueRule: positive net correctness over strongest native arm on multiple sources/capabilities; independent grounding audit
protocol.disclosure: Qwen Gateway timestamped 128-frame input, no native audio; generated ASR must be declared separately
protocol.inconclusiveRule: missing core coverage, weak/mixed signal, missing audit; pause expansion
protocol.inputConditions: Video-MME supplied subtitles separate from audio; LVB timestamped official subtitles required
protocol.inspectionAmendment: Canonical inspector currently bounds inspection chunks at 60 seconds; at most two bounded inspections per question, four agent steps.
protocol.missingness: original planned denominator retained; infrastructure failures null
protocol.stopRule: completed valid pilot with no positive correctness benefit
protocol.subtitleCondition: Full aligned official subtitles where available; Qwen receives separately declared canonical Deepgram ASR for a source without official subtitles. Native models retain full audio.
